Public Comments

Please email all public comments to CScommission@sgch.org and include the following on the subject line
of your email: the section (Public Comment, Consent, Public Hearing, Continued Business, New Business)
and Item Number you are commenting on. The Staff will read public comments into the record for up to
the three-minute limit. Words that would disrupt the meeting, including profanity, obscenity, and
discriminatory language, will not be read.
Example: PUBLIC COMMENT: New Business Item A

   City of San Gabriel
  MEMORANDUM
DATE:  November 1, 2021

TO:  Community Services Commission

FROM:  Community Services Department Staff

BY:  Christina Alatorre, Recreation Supervisor

SUBJECT:  Monthly Department Report

Aquatics
San Gabriel Public Works staff have been working diligently to maintain the pool at Smith
Park during the off-season. They have repaired a majority of lamp lights inside the pool
and overseen the contractual repairs for the pool heater.

The San Gabriel Sea Gulls continue to train and will host their Annual Halloween Meet on
Saturday, October 30. The meet will be held virtually.

Contract Classes
Staff are currently updating the Contract Class program including updating the instructor
agreement, developing an instructor manual and creating an instructor insurance policy.
The anticipated start date for these changes is Winter 2021. The goal is to create a
uniformed process for all instructors, limit liability for the City, enhance interdepartmental
efficiency and provide and a high level of service to instructors and participants.

Since the reopening of California in June 2021 staff have worked to bring back classes in
person in a safe manner. There has been a positive response from the public and it shows
in the registration numbers. In Spring 2021 we had 72 registrants, in Summer 2021 we
had 193 registrants, followed by a slight drop (usual for the winter session) to 158
registrants during Fall 2021. We anticipate it will continue to grow as participants feel
more comfortable recreating in group settings and as staff continue to bring on new
instructors and enhance marketing methods.

Facilities and Picnic Rentals
The Grapevine Arbor, the lawn area at the Adult Recreation Center, will be closed the

  4-A
 month of November for reseeding and general maintenance.

Older Adult Programs and Trips
Community Services staff, along with the YWCA of San Gabriel Valley, continue do an
excellent job to serving approximately 200 senior residents weekly in the drive-thru meal
program. The upcoming senior trip includes the Festival of Lights at the Mission Inn. Trips
for the winter season will be announced in the upcoming weeks. To submit a trip idea or
request please email Matthew Morales-Stevens, Recreation Supervisor at
mmoralesstevens@sgch.org.

Youth Programs
The after school programs at Coolidge, McKinley, Washington and Wilson Elementary
Schools have a daily attendance of 25-30 participants. Staff have been doing an excellent
job engaging participants through planned seasonal activities. On the week of October
25th staff celebrated the spooky season with a Trunk-or-Treat at each school site.

The Jefferson Middle School volleyball clinic has an average attendance of 20-25
participants. This program has allowed Jefferson students to engage in sport afterschool.
Participants provided positive feedback about the program.

Special Events
Dia De Los Muertos – The Community Services Department is offering a variety of events
for the Dia De Los Muertos celebration, including, Art in the Arbor, Drive-In Concert and
a Community Altar. On Wednesday, November 3 the City is offering Art in the Arbor at
5:15 pm located in the Grapevine Arbor. This event is a spin off the successful Art in Park
program. Over 22 families have registered to decorate sugar skulls in the transformed
arbor and learn about this cultural event.
The San Gabriel Community Altar will be on display Thursday, November 4 from 4:30-8:30
pm in the Grapevine Arbor. This altar is intended to honor the deceased loved ones of the
San Gabriel community. Altar photos are being accepted until Tuesday, November 3.
Photos can be submitted by emailing Christina Alatorre at calatorre@sgch.org.

The Dia De Los Muertos festivities will conclude with a drive-in concert on Thursday,
November 4 at 6:00pm. The concert will feature the Grammy Award winning Mariachi
Divas. This concert will be held in the Mission Playhouse Parking Lot. Registration is
required.

  4-A
 Holiday Tree Lighting Ceremony – The Holiday Tree Lighting event will take place, with
little to no modifications to the event, on Tuesday, December 7 at Plaza Park. The event
will include a visit by Santa, hot cocoa, photos and crafts. The San Gabriel Women’s
Foundation will be partnering with the City to provide the craft.

Holiday Basket Program – The Holiday Basket Program will be modified as it was in 2020
to ensure the health of participants and volunteers. It will be held at the Mission Playhouse
Parking Lot in a drive-thru format on December 11, 2021. The Women’s Foundation
gathers donations of food and other essentials to provide to seniors and families in need
during the holiday season. The San Gabriel Fire Department, through their Spark of Love
Toy Drive, provides gifts and the Community Services Department provides take home
crafts for the youth participants. The event is only open to participants that the San Gabriel
Unified School District or the Women’s Foundation has deemed in need of the service. If
you or someone you know is interested in volunteering please email Danielle Adriano,
Recreation Specialist at dadriano@sgch.org.

Native American Heritage Month – City staff in conjunction with the HEAR Commission
is pleased to celebrate Native American Heritage Month through a variety of methods.
The San Gabriel City Council will formally celebrate this month through a proclamation
during the November 2 City Council meeting. The City is also offering an essay contest
and will present an informational and celebratory video on November 1 through the City’s
Youtube Channel. Additionally, the San Gabriel Public Library will offer a book display and
onsite programs. For more information on any of these items please visit:
www.SanGabrielCity.com/1577.
